title: Provisional sloppiness formula (trellis-00d5): grouped dimensions, count+density terms, worst-case missing policy
rationale: SCORING_FORMULA (src/scoring/formula.ts) pins weights 0.50/0.30/0.20 and saturation thresholds under SCORING_VERSION 0.1.0-provisional; any recalibration bumps version + tests together (trellis-e924 calibrates). Overlapping complexity/erosion/size grouped into ONE dimension to avoid double-penalty; each dimension blends an absolute-count term with its density term 50/50 so large clean additions cannot dilute hotspot counts (SPEC 3.4). Production set only — test metrics never offset. Missing/incomplete/absent required metric => dimension scores at FULL weight (never zero debt) + partial flag; not-applicable ratio with complete zero counts = genuinely empty scope = 0. Index = clamp(roundHalfUp(sum weight*dim),0,100); contributions are largest-remainder integer apportionment (ties by dimension id) so they sum EXACTLY to the index. scoreSloppiness takes NO config input so policy budgets cannot mutate weights; partial = any input metric incomplete OR required metric absent — the ef85 assembler must emit every analyzer metric so the 6.4 invariant (partial == report completeness rollup) holds. IEEE-754 gotcha for golden tests: x/(2x) and doubling are exact, so pick fixture values like 0.075/0.15 to get binary-exact expectations.
